hooks.command: jq -c 'if (.tool_input.subagent_type // "") == "fork" then empty elif ((.tool_input.model // "") | length) == 0 then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Agent dispatch has no `model` set. Omitting it is not a neutral default - the subagent INHERITS the session model, so a premium session silently spawns premium agents. Set model explicitly: haiku for mechanical work (extraction, pattern-following edits, structured search), sonnet for judgement work (multi-file reasoning, convention-holding prose), opus for a CODE REVIEW - that tier is standing for reviews and is not asked about, see CLAUDE.md - A review runs on opus. See CLAUDE.md - Subagent dispatch."}} elif ((((.tool_input.model // "") | ascii_downcase) == "opus") and (((.tool_input.description // "") | ascii_downcase) | test("^(re-?)?review[ :]"))) then empty elif ((.tool_input.isolation // "") != "worktree") then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Agent dispatch does not set isolation to worktree. Every subagent that WRITES works in its own worktree, never the session clone: the dispatcher opens and closes it, the agent stays in the path it is given, runs no git, and never commits. A premium-model authorisation grants a model tier, not an isolation exemption. Forks and code reviews are the carve-outs - a review writes nothing, so it reads the session tree directly and gets no worktree. See CLAUDE.md - Subagent dispatch."}} elif ((.tool_input.model // "") | ascii_downcase | test("opus|fable")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("Agent dispatch requests the premium model \"" + (.tool_input.model) + "\". Per CLAUDE.md, opus/fable are forbidden for subagents unless you explicitly asked for that tier - EXCEPT a code review, which is standing on opus and passes without asking. Approve only if you asked for this tier.")}} else empty end'

f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../agent-fabric/runtime/claude-code/hooks/subagent-clone-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then bash "$f"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The subagent clone guard script was not found beside this clone; approve only if this tool call is not a subagent writing in the session clone."}}'; fi

f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../agent-fabric/communication/gzcoord/scripts/inbox.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] && node "$f"; echo "gzcoord: the drain above is a snapshot. Start the session-length inbox watch NOW, before any other work (CLAUDE.md, Agent communication)."; true

f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../agent-fabric/runtime/claude-code/hooks/model-switch-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then bash "$f"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreModelSwitch","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The model-switch guard script was not found beside this clone; in a broker session a bare model id runs without its family shim. Approve only if the target is a composite or needs no shim."}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: agent-fabric: checking the switch keeps its family shim…
